title: feat: LIVE JAPAN 生きている日本列島の体験試作
head: feat/live-japan-experience-prototype
body:
## 目的
「暮らしを、少し先回りする」を体験するため、MYアメふるを壊さず独立ルート `/live-japan` にインタラクティブな日本地図の試作を追加。

## 内容
- Leaflet/OpenStreetMapの日本地図を夜景風に演出
- 光るサンプル地点（北海道/東京/大阪/沖縄）をタップするとストーリーカード
- 「これまで／いま／このあと」時間軸のUI
- スマホ対応、低モーション設定対応

## 重要な制限
**サンプル地点・時間軸はすべてデザインデモで、実際の気象・災害イベントや予測ではありません。** 画面内にも明示。公式データとの接続、時刻/出典/鮮度/不明表示は後続作業。既存MYアメふる、本番、DBには変更なし。

## 確認
静的なコード追加のみ。ビルド・実機表示・地図タイル表示は未検証。まずプレビューで画面を見て方向性を決める。

title: Add nationwide heavy-rain scan proof
head: feat/national-heavy-rain-preview
body:
## 最新チェックポイント — 2026-10-13

**この先頭セクションが旧記述より優先。** PR #59 は OPEN・未merge。Production readiness は **NO**。Production migration / cron / Vault / Storage書込 / watch-rain・Push接続 / deployは未実施。

- 最新のコード検証基準: commit `b8598105b1a5d03828355844efa838db15b35c89` の CI #782 と関連する5つのproof workflowは成功。ドキュメントのみの追記コミットは `c0ba2f5`、`49f7a8f`、`3027d41`。
- CI #784（run `38310431611`、commit `c0ba2f55485e8551c9982824b9caf75b8fb5ad06`）は、確認時点で **in progress**。npm install / audit artifact / npm test / z4全国フレーム走査は成功済み。z4→z8 descendant validationは実行中。\n- 最新PR HEAD `3027d4107d2a971bd2e090eddb1754fbb89003b8`（docs-only更新）でも CI #785 と JMA z4→z10 / National rain / N03 index / All47 ownership / N03 conversion の関連workflowが新規起動し、確認時点で **in progress**。これらの最終結論はまだ未確認。
- CI #784の監査artifact `npm-dependency-audit-report`（artifact `11774227824`）を実際に展開して確認: **Critical 2 / High 1 / Moderate 2 / Total 5**。対象は `vitest`、`tinypool`、`postcss`、`next`、`@vitest/mocker`。提示された修正候補 `vitest@5.0.4` と `next@16.4.0` はmajor updateを伴うため、まだ適用していない。旧Vitest候補 `5.0.3` はこのartifactに対して古い。
- `package-lock.json` が未追跡でCIが `npm install` を使用しているため、依存ツリーは固定されていない。次の安全な作業はlockfile導入・`npm ci`検証と、major/non-major修正の分離。 `npm audit fix --force` は実行しない。
- 実際のPreview workerが、partitioned 32 MiB loader / region ownership-gather / queue-aware dispatcher / in-flight deadline cancellationをまだ使っていないこと、throughput/scheduler gateがOPENであることは変更なし。proof-onlyの測定をProduction readinessと読み替えない。

正本と作業順: [PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md](docs/PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md)、[AMAFURU_HANDOFF_2026-10-13.md](docs/AMAFURU_HANDOFF_2026-10-13.md)、[NATIONAL_RAIN_READINESS_PROOF.md](docs/NATIONAL_RAIN_READINESS_PROOF.md)。

---

## Current state — authoritative checkpoint

PR #59 remains an isolated nationwide heavy-rain proof. Production notification paths remain disconnected.

Latest integration checkpoint: `8f4bf24` (records branch state after Work handoff). Before that, runtime/proof head `3a6827c` completed:
- CI #507 SUCCESS
- National rain proof #211 SUCCESS
- N03 national prefecture index proof #131 SUCCESS
- All47 ownership proof #5 SUCCESS
- 38 test files / 187 tests passed, queue lifecycle and build passed

### What is now proven
- Atomic scan→queue behavior is fail-closed and idempotent.
- Exact raster footprint + N03 municipality intersection works.
- Exact original polygon-component partitioning preserves boundaries/holes.
- Encoded 32 MiB bounded cache supports eviction, single-flight and bounded retention.
- Regional locality materially outperforms mixed-national cache churn in local HTTP proofs.
- All47 geometry/ownership proof: 47 prefectures, 502 chunks, 591 queries, ordered municipality equivalence preserved.
- Deadline-tail proof cancels in-flight proof HTTP around 42 s and returns claimed jobs to queue: offered 100, claimed 2, deferred 2, unclaimed 98, failed 0.

### Important integration gap
The newest safety architecture is still **proof-only**.

The actual Preview worker route still uses:
- `processNationalRainRefinementJobs()`
- `createSupabaseN03AdministrativeAreaLoader()`

It does **not yet** use the partitioned 32 MiB loader, ownership/gather path, queue-aware dispatcher, or in-flight AbortSignal deadline handling proven in scripts.

So this PR has proved a safer architecture, but the application worker is not yet running that architecture.

### Scheduler status
The proof cron migration still contains fixed primary + drain calls with `limit=50`. Later evidence rejects fixed 50x2 scheduling as a rollout design. Keep that migration unapplied; it is historical proof scaffolding, not an accepted scheduler.

### Architecture direction
Do not adopt pure byte-balanced all47 LPT ownership as the final topology. It proves deterministic complete ownership, but it can scatter unrelated prefectures across owners and lose the regional-locality benefit already measured.

Preferred convergence:
1. preserve geographic/regional locality;
2. split heavy prefectures into exact chunks;
3. load only intersecting chunks through the encoded 32 MiB cache;
4. keep a small global invocation cap (cap2 baseline; cap4 not accepted);
5. refill from observed backlog with fairness instead of fixed calls;
6. use deadline admission + in-flight cancellation + explicit final DB-RPC reserve;
7. gather only complete owner results before publishing municipality output.

### Gate status
**Atomicity gate: CLOSED.**  
**Throughput/scheduler gate: OPEN.**  
**Production readiness: NO.**

Still required:
- integrate the proven loader/worker safety path into the actual Preview route;
- bound final DB claim/save/finish/defer RPCs inside the runtime budget;
- define/measure final region-local ownership across all47;
- validate severe-load sustained drain;
- measure authorized real Storage/DB/JMA IO and target Vercel runtime memory/headroom;
- define stale-frame handling, regional/global leases/fairness and final dispatcher cadence.

No Production migration/cron/Vault/Storage changes, watch-rain/Push connection, PR merge or intentional Production deploy have been performed.

Full handoff and rationale: `docs/PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md` and `docs/NATIONAL_RAIN_READINESS_PROOF.md`.

### New low-zoom screening evidence
JMA low-zoom max-rank proof #1 SUCCESS on live observation frame `20260930113000`.
- 1,536 z8 tiles
- 393,216 z4 parent pixels
- 6,078 z8 pixels >=30 mm/h
- missed heavy pixels: 0
- z4 parent below max z8 descendant rank: 0
- exact max-rank matches: 393,216 / 393,216 (100%)

This strongly suggests z4 can act as a max-rank coarse screen before z8 refinement, potentially cutting nationwide detail load substantially. It is **not yet adopted as a hard invariant** because this is one live observation frame, not a published JMA guarantee. Repeat across observation + forecast frames and diverse events before using z4<30 as a safe exclusion rule.


### Candidate-only refinement result (CI #523)
Fresh live forecast cycle, 12 validtimes (+5 to +60 min):
- all six z4 coarse tiles available for all 12 frames;
- only z4 >=30 mm/h candidates were refined;
- every requested candidate descendant tile was available at z5, z6, z7, z8, z9 and **z10**;
- highest fully available candidate zoom = **10 for all 12 frames**;
- candidate footprint per frame was tiny (about 1 tile at z5-z7, 2 at z8, 4 at z9, 6-9 at z10).

This clarifies the earlier 404s: exhaustive nationwide high-zoom requests can be unavailable, while the high-zoom tiles actually needed for strong-rain candidates may still be fully available. Preferred architecture is therefore z4 nationwide screening -> candidate-only high-zoom refinement -> N03/municipality work. Keep missing selected tiles as NO_DATA/fail-closed.


### Sparse-tile hypothesis result (CI #526)
We directly tested whether completely dry high-zoom forecast tiles are omitted. They are not, at least in this live sample: across nearest/middle/farthest forecast horizons, 300/300 z10 tiles selected from fully transparent z4 child blocks returned HTTP 200, and all 300 decoded as fully transparent PNGs. Wet-class samples were also 300/300 HTTP 200. So the earlier 404s are **not explained by 'dry area => no file'**. Keep 404 as NO_DATA/unavailable and investigate coverage/product availability separately.

title: Reduce repeated rain-ending notifications
head: fix/rain-ending-hysteresis
body:
## Summary
- keep the rain-ending notification latched through dry/forecast wobble
- rearm it only after 3 consecutive RAIN observations confirm a new rain episode
- preserve all rain diagnostics and underlying classification behavior
- ensure a confirmed new episode can still emit a legitimate ending notification
- add focused hysteresis tests

## Scope
Push notification gating only. No rain thresholds, provider logic, diagnostics, location registration, or UI changes.

title: Suppress duplicate rain-ending alerts after transient rain
head: fix/rain-ending-after-confirmed-rain
body: After an episode has fully cleared, a single transient RAIN sample must not re-arm the rain-ending notification. RAIN_ENDING is now eligible only when the previously confirmed weather state is RAINING. Existing 3-check rain confirmation, clear confirmation, Push delivery handling, severe-rain alerts, and radar display are unchanged.

title: Overlay current JMA rain radar on map picker
head: feat/rain-radar-layer
body: Adds the latest JMA high-resolution precipitation nowcast as a semi-transparent visual layer over the Leaflet map picker. This is display-only: existing rain classification, monitoring, and notification logic are unchanged. The base map remains usable if the radar metadata or tiles cannot load.

title: Show map preview for coordinate picker
head: feat/visual-map-picker
body: Adds a visual OpenStreetMap preview to the coordinate-based monitoring location flow. The existing current-location and address search flows remain unchanged. This lets users visually verify offshore/addressless coordinates before registration, while keeping the implementation small before adding direct map-tap selection.

title: Add coordinate-based map location registration
head: feat/map-location-picker
body: Adds a map-location registration entry point for monitoring arbitrary coordinates, including offshore and addressless locations. Keeps current-location and place search flows unchanged. Reverse geocoding is best-effort; raw coordinates remain registrable when no address exists. Marks these targets with location_source MAP. This is the first safe step toward a visual map/rain-overlay picker.

title: Restore rain-ending notification decision
head: fix/restore-rain-ending-decision
body: Restore the rainEnding input to the shared notification helper so watch-rain keeps sending the already field-verified 'もうすぐ止みそう' Push after the latest main is deployed. This fixes drift introduced when the notification decision was extracted. No threshold, wording, severe-rain, or DB changes.

title: Track rain confirmation independently of push delivery
head: fix/internal-rain-confirmation-state
body: Make the existing rain_confirmed_notified state flag represent internal rain confirmation rather than successful Push delivery. This is required now that standalone RAIN_CONFIRMED Push is intentionally suppressed. The flag still resets after three consecutive NO_RAIN checks. No notification thresholds, severe-rain behavior, or DB schema changes.

title: Update project overview from code, DB, and production state
head: docs/update-project-overview-20260928
body: Refresh the root project overview as the operational source of truth after cross-checking GitHub main, the live Supabase schema/state/history, and deployed Edge Function versions. Records current rain/Push policy, palette, six active test targets, production-vs-main drift, field-test evidence, and the future per-location timeline diagnostic view. Documentation only; no runtime or DB changes.

title: Keep confirmed rain internal instead of pushing it
head: fix/suppress-rain-confirmed-push
body: Keep 3-consecutive-RAIN confirmation for internal episode/state management, but do not send or persist a standalone RAIN_CONFIRMED notification. If confirmation coincides with RAIN_ENDING, notify only the forward-looking RAIN_ENDING message. Severe, approaching, returning, and ending notifications remain unchanged.

title: Refresh latest alerts at Tokyo midnight
head: fix/refresh-alerts-at-tokyo-midnight
body: Refresh the 今日の最新アラート list automatically just after 00:00 JST when the app remains open. Existing Tokyo-date filtering is unchanged; this only schedules a UI refresh at the day boundary.

title: Disambiguate duplicate notification labels with place names
head: fix/disambiguate-duplicate-notification-labels
body: When multiple enabled watch targets share the same label, append the existing display_name to notification copy (e.g. 大雨の予報（白浜） / 大雨の予報（子浦）). Unique labels remain unchanged. Rain detection, monitoring cadence, and notification trigger logic are unchanged.

title: Recognize verified JMA 20–30 mm/h PNG color
head: fix/jma-20-30-palette
body:
## Summary
- recognize JMA hrpns PNG RGB(250,245,0) / #FAF500 as `20_TO_30`
- remove that verified color from the UNKNOWN_PIXEL test set
- add a regression test asserting `RAIN` + `20_TO_30`

## Field evidence
At the newly added Minamiizu/Ko-ura test location, the 12:00 JST monitoring run returned #FAF500 in current/forecast frames while also forecasting 30–50 and 50–80 mm/h rain. Treating #FAF500 as UNKNOWN withheld interpretation and therefore blocked the severe-rain path.

No notification logic, database schema, or other palette colors are changed.

title: Brighten secondary text for clearer hierarchy
head: design/white-secondary-text
body: 実機デザイン確認を受け、小さい説明文・住所・通知時刻などの補助文字を白系へ変更します。背景、カード、レイアウト、雨判定、Pushロジックは変更しません。

title: Restore visual hierarchy on light blue theme
head: design/restore-visual-contrast
body: 背景の明るい青は維持しつつ、カードだけ濃く戻して背景との差を作り、主要文と補助文の文字コントラストを整理します。レイアウト・機能・雨判定・Pushには変更ありません。

title: Lighten blue theme and move rain result above alerts
head: design/lighter-blue-result-order
body: 実機確認を受けて、青系テーマをさらに一段明るくし、現在地の雨確認結果を「今日の最新アラート」より前へ移動します。機能・雨判定・Push・履歴データは変更しません。

title: Lighten rain-blue visual theme
head: design/lighter-rain-blue
body: 実機スクリーンショットを基準に、濃紺の雰囲気を保ちながら背景・カード・補助文字を1〜2段明るくします。レイアウト、機能、雨判定、Pushロジックは変更しません。

title: Refresh EmergencyAlert mobile design
head: design/polished-mobile-ui
body: 機能・雨判定・Pushロジックは変更せず、スマホ優先でUIのみ刷新します。濃紺＋雨空の背景、半透明カード、強い主CTA、監視ONの黄緑を軸にしたデザインPreviewです。名称は現行の「アメくる？」のままです。

title: Keep rain check prompt and button together
head: fix/keep-rain-check-together
body: 「このあとの雨、見てみる？」と確認ボタンの間に最新アラートが入らないよう、確認ボタンをstatus直下へ戻します。表示順のみの最小修正です。

title: Keep short rain gaps in the same episode
head: feat/rain-returning-copy
body:
実地観測で確認した短い雨の途切れを同一エピソードとして表現します。

- confirmed_weather=RAINING のまま clear_streak が1〜2の時は同じ雨
- その状態で生活通知条件を満たしたら「いったん弱まってるけど、また降りそう」
- notification event_type は RAIN_RETURNING
- 3回連続 NO_RAIN 後は従来どおり新しい雨として扱う
- 防災通知・3回確定・v27複合通知は変更なし

title: Make rain notifications context-aware
head: fix/natural-rain-notifications
body:
実地通知で確認した「止みそう→降った」の違和感を改善。

- 3回RAIN確定と RAIN_ENDING が同時なら「いま雨＋もうすぐ止みそう」を1本で通知
- 実際に伝えた内容に合わせて notification event_type を保存
- RAIN_CONFIRMED / RAIN_CONFIRMED_ENDING を導入
- 強雨防災通知も専用イベント種別と DISASTER urgency で履歴化
- 判定速度・3回確認・防災閾値は変更なし
- 総覧に通知文脈ルールを追記

title: Add severe rain forecast alert layer
head: feat/severe-rain-alerts
body:
## 変更
- 30–50 / 50–80 / 80+ mm/h の予測を防災通知レイヤーとして追加
- 現在すでに降雨中でも将来の強雨化を通知
- 同一降雨では同段階を再通知せず、上位段階への悪化のみ追加通知
- 3回連続 NO_RAIN で防災通知段階をリセット
- 警報・注意報とは別の降水強度予測であることを総覧に明記

既存の生活通知、降った/止んだ確定、止みそう通知は維持。

title: Confirm observed rain facts after three checks
head: feat/confirmed-rain-facts
body:
## 変更
- 総覧（README）に「予測は早さ優先、結果は確実性優先」を追加
- 降った: 現在観測 RAIN 3回連続で確定・同一降雨で1回通知
- 止んだ: NO_RAIN 3回連続で確定、Pushは送らない
- 同一降雨の RAIN_ENDING 再通知抑制を維持
- 本番 watch-rain v25 のソースをGitHubへ同期

雨予測エンジン自体の閾値・判定条件は変更していません。

title: Add today's latest delivered alerts
head: feature/latest-alerts
body: Adds a Today latest alerts card backed by successful Push delivery records. The app shows the latest successfully delivered notification per watched location for the current local day. Also syncs successful-delivery persistence into the repository watch-rain source. No rain classification or notification-decision conditions are changed.

title: Fix dry forecast boundary at cron tick
head: fix/dry-forecast-boundary
body:
## Summary
- determine forecast completeness from the full JMA forecast series, not only frames whose validTime is still in the future
- keep rain/actionable searches scoped to future frames
- add regression coverage for a cron run 5 seconds after a 5-minute JMA boundary
- preserve INSUFFICIENT_DATA when any forecast frame is invalid

## Why
Production diagnostics showed all 12 forecast frames were valid NO_RAIN, but the first frame was ~5 seconds behind the cron execution time. Filtering it out left 11 future frames, so DRY could never satisfy the old 12/12 completeness check.

No Push decision, notification copy, intensity threshold, or RAIN_ENDING logic is changed.

title: Add forecast-frame rain diagnostics
head: diagnostic-forecast-frames
body: Adds per-forecast-frame diagnostic details (time, status, intensity class, RGBA) only when interpretation is withheld. No rain classification, notification, or UI behavior changes.

title: Fix transparent JMA pixels blocking dry/ending states
head: fix/jma-transparent-no-rain
body: Treat fully transparent JMA high-resolution precipitation PNG pixels as NO_RAIN, based on captured field evidence showing the same location transition transparent → verified rain palette → transparent as rain passed. Unknown opaque colors remain fail-closed as UNKNOWN_PIXEL. Adds coverage for both transparent black and transparent white RGBA values observed in production diagnostics.

title: Log withheld rain diagnostics
head: chore/log-rain-diagnostics
body: Logs the existing diagnostic payload when `/api/rain` withholds a user-facing interpretation. No rain classification, Push, database, or UI behavior changes.

title: Add rain interpretation diagnostics
head: chore/rain-diagnostics
body: Adds non-invasive diagnostic fields to /api/rain when a user-facing interpretation is withheld. No rain classification, notification, or UI behavior is changed. This will identify the interpretation state, current frame status, and forecast completeness on the next reproduction.

title: Deduplicate place search results
head: fix/dedupe-place-search-results
body: 施設・地名検索で、同一住所または座標が50m以内の検索結果を1件にまとめます。監視地点の登録ロジックや既存データには触れません。

title: Prevent duplicate watch target registration
head: fix/prevent-duplicate-watch-targets
body:
## What
- check the current user's existing watch targets before inserting a new one
- treat a location within 50 meters as already registered
- show the existing label instead of creating a duplicate

## Why
The same Shiohama home location was registered twice, which can cause duplicate monitoring and duplicate Push delivery.

## Scope
Registration guard only. Existing data is not deleted or modified.

title: Refine persistent light-rain notification boundary
head: fix/persistent-light-rain-notification
body:
## What
- keep <1 mm/h drizzle silent
- treat three consecutive 5-minute 1–5 mm/h rain frames as actionable when the run starts within 30 minutes
- preserve the existing >=5 mm/h within 30 minutes rule
- do not bridge UNKNOWN gaps
- do not emit approaching-rain notification once rain is already underway

## Why
The first production rain event in Shiohama was detected as RAINING/INFO but never became actionable. This change keeps the product quiet for drizzle while allowing sustained light rain to trigger an advance lifestyle notification.

## Safety
No changes to JMA source interpretation, palette mapping, UNKNOWN handling, Push delivery, Supabase, or watch scheduling.

title: Restore push notification status after reopening app
head: fix/restore-push-status-on-load
body:
アプリ再起動後に既存のPush購読状態を復元します。

- Notification permission が granted の場合だけ確認
- Service Worker の既存Push subscriptionを確認
- 購読済みなら「✓ 通知ON」と表示
- 雨判定、5分監視、Push配信ロジックには変更なし

title: Use targetTimes member in JMA early forecast tile URL
head: fix/jma-early-forecast-member-path
body:
## Summary
- replace the hard-coded `none` path segment with `frame.member`
- extend the URL builder input type to require `member`
- cover both `immed` and `none` frames in unit tests

## Scope
This is intentionally limited to the JMA Early Rain Forecast tile URL builder and its unit test. No Push, Supabase, or Production configuration changes.

title: test: verify live JMA early rain data in CI
head: test-jma-early-live-smoke
body: Adds a narrow pull-request smoke check that fetches live JMA precipitation short-range forecast data at a fixed Tokyo-area test coordinate and fails if no usable frames are returned. It does not touch app behavior, Push, Supabase, or production monitoring.

title: test: cover early rain prototype API
head: test-early-rain-api-smoke
body: Adds isolated smoke coverage for /api/rain/early: successful forecast response/firstRain selection, invalid coordinates, and fail-closed behavior when JMA data is unavailable. No production behavior changes.

title: feat: expose early rain forecast prototype API
head: feat-early-rain-forecast-api-v2
body: Rebased replacement for #21 on the latest main. Adds only the read-only prototype endpoint at /api/rain/early?lat=...&lon=.... It returns forecast frames and firstRain for verification; it does not alter the existing /api/rain path or send Push notifications.

title: fix: clear place search UI after registration
head: fix-clear-place-search-after-save
body: After a watch target is successfully registered, clear the search query, search result card, and per-result label state. The success message and saved watch target list remain visible. No auth, monitoring, Push, or rain logic changes.

title: feat: expose early rain forecast prototype API
head: feat-early-rain-forecast-api
body: Adds a read-only prototype endpoint at /api/rain/early?lat=...&lon=... so the new several-hours-ahead JMA provider can be verified against real locations. It returns forecast frames and firstRain only; it does not alter the existing /api/rain path or send Push notifications.

title: feat: add early rain forecast provider
head: feat-early-rain-forecast-provider
body: Adds an isolated JMA rasrf provider for several-hours-ahead rain forecasts. Existing high-resolution nowcast and Push behavior are unchanged. The provider fetches rasrf target times, reads only the registered location tile pixel, classifies rain intensity using the existing palette logic, and exposes the first forecast rain frame. Includes URL regression coverage.

title: fix: avoid false push test failure status
head: fix-push-test-status
body: The authenticated Edge Function returns HTTP 200 and the iPhone receives the notification, but the client can falsely show failure due to relying on the parsed response payload. Treat a successful Supabase function invocation as success and keep transport errors as failures.

title: Verify seven JMA PNG bands; withdraw unsupported yellow mapping
head: codex/verify-jma-png-palette-20260923
body:
## Problem and result
The previous three-color subset used circle assets without establishing their layer semantics. Current JMA XML identifies those circles as AMeDAS ten-minute rainfall symbols, not hrpns intensity.

Direct inspection of the live JMA browser DOM, loaded resources, linked XML/JS, dedicated hrpns SVGs and original PNG tiles corroborates seven intensity bands. Add five mappings and retain two independently reverified mappings. Withdraw #FAF500 → 20–30: all three hrpns SVGs specify #FFF500, while live PNG bytes contain #FAF500. Both yellows and AMeDAS-only #00AAFF/#FFAA00 remain UNKNOWN_PIXEL.

## Evidence
Update PNG_PALETTE_EVIDENCE.md and PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md with the source chain, SVG boundary geometry, exact RGB table and correction. Archive JMA originals with URLs, SHA-256, raw RGBA counts and sample coordinates, including native zoom 10. All 22 archived source/excerpt hashes were verified against the remote commit. Source bytes retain their original line endings; application files retain repository line endings.

## Validation
At head 891318d7026f1c90209341a48c38ec8df0d879e8, [CI run 83](https://github.com/miyazaki1016/emergencyalert/actions/runs/35849772648) passed: 13 test files / 79 tests and the production build (including type checks).

Tests cover all seven corroborated classes and the archived raw PNG, withdrawn yellow, SVG-only yellow, AMeDAS-only colors, partial alpha, provider UNKNOWN_PIXEL preservation and watcher change detection without promotion. The test PNG helper returns ArrayBuffer for current TypeScript BodyInit compatibility. Local type checking also passed; local Vitest was blocked by Windows child-process EPERM, so full execution was verified in GitHub CI.

20–30 remains unresolved; transparency/coverage semantics require separate verification. This is not a declaration of production readiness. No changes to miyazaki1016/emergencyalert.kishibojim.online.
